opportunities.title: Publicidad y Redes Podología
opportunities.description: Tengo un centro de masajes y podología que necesita una presencia más atractiva en redes sociales. Quiero centrarme en Facebook para aumentar el número de reservas de citas, por lo que busco a alguien que diseñe todo el material publicitario necesario y deje mi página lista para convertir visitas en clientes. Qué espero recibir • Piezas gráficas profesionales para Facebook (posts, historias y portada) alineadas con el estilo de bienestar y salud del negocio. • Textos breves y persuasivos que motiven a reservar, con llamados a la acción claros. • Un calendario de publicaciones de al menos cuatro semanas, equilibrado entre contenidos informativos, testimonios y promociones. • Optimización de la página de Facebook: portada, sección “Información”, botón “Reservar” y plantillas de respuestas rápidas para Messenger. • Recomendaciones básicas de métricas clave (alcance, clics en “Reservar”, coste por resultado) para que pueda medir el impacto. Requisitos y forma de trabajo – Cuida la coherencia visual: colores relajantes, tipografías legibles y fotografías que transmitan confianza e higiene. – Entrega los archivos editables (PSD, AI o Canva) y versiones listas para publicar en 1080×1080 px y 1080×1920 px. – Valoro que propongas ideas creativas basadas en buenas prácticas de marketing para servicios de salud. – Comunicación clara por chat; necesito avances semanales y apertura a un par de rondas de ajustes. Si tienes experiencia demostrable gestionando Facebook para spas, clínicas o negocios de bienestar y puedes mostrar resultados en reservas, estarás en ventaja. Espero tu propuesta con ejemplos y plazos aproximados.

opportunities.title: Videos cortos promocionales redes sociales
opportunities.description: Soy Florencia Silba y quiero impulsar mis productos y servicios con videos cortos pensados para historias y reels. Busco a alguien creativo que: • Desarrolle ideas dinámicas y coherentes con mi marca. • Grabe o edite material existente en formato vertical 9:16 (ideal 15-30 s). • Aplique transiciones, subtítulos y música libre de derechos que enganchen desde el primer segundo. • Entregue los videos listos en MP4 y, si es posible, los archivos editables para futuros ajustes. Aprecio propuestas que incluyan conceptos, estilo visual y llamadas a la acción claras. Priorizo la estética cuidada, ritmo ágil y mensajes que conviertan. Si dominas herramientas como Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut o similares y entiendes las tendencias de Instagram y TikTok, me encantará ver tu portafolio y acordar un calendario de entregas.

opportunities.title: Editor Viral para Reels y TikTok
opportunities.description: Busco editor de contenido viral (Reels / TikTok), remoto, pago por video Hola Soy Grego, de AYRO, marca argentina de ventiladores de cuello. Busco un editor que sepa hacer contenido que se comparta, no solo que quede lindo. Instagram: instagram.com/ayro.arg TikTok: tiktok.com/@ayro.ar Web: ayro.ar Reels editados que funcionaron: instagram.com/reel/DfsxFcRjSYc (121.000 vistas) instagram.com/reel/DflCtOREkqL (52.000 vistas) instagram.com/reel/DfdUXlRjjTF (20.000 vistas) Cómo trabajamos Te paso material crudo: videos de creadores con el producto, cosas que grabo yo y viajes. Sacás los clips con más chances de pegar: hook en 2 segundos, ritmo, subtítulos y música en tendencia. Publicamos y medimos. Lo que pega, lo exprimimos con variantes hasta que se queme. Lo que no pega, se baja y se recicla en otro video (otro hook, orden o audio) hasta que funcione. Busco a alguien que entienda por qué un video se viraliza y proponga cambios cuando algo no anda. Pago Volumen variable: de 5 a 40 clips por semana. Ganás entre USD 5 y 50 por video. Incluye 1 ronda de cambios, entrega en 48 a 72 h y pago semanal.

opportunities.description: Soy filósofo, teólogo y tecnólogo en sistemas con amplia experiencia en análisis, resolución de problemas y gestión de información. Para un conjunto de proyectos en curso necesito refuerzo puntual en tareas de redacción e investigación. Qué espero de tu apoyo • Localizar y analizar fuentes confiables (artículos académicos, publicaciones especializadas, datos estadísticos). • Sintetizar la información y elaborar borradores claros y bien estructurados en español. • Ajustar el tono y formato según el público objetivo: desde documentos académicos hasta textos divulgativos o informes ejecutivos. • Entregar versiones editables y referencias bibliográficas completas. Mi tarifa estimada es de USD 6 por hora. Estoy interesado en colaborar en proyectos de investigación, redacción y análisis de contenidos, aportando responsabilidad, compromiso y atención al detalle.

opportunities.title: Editor de Animaciones 2D Sociales
opportunities.description: Necesito la creación de animaciones 2D orientadas a contenido para youtube y convertirlas en videos listos para publicar. La tarea incluye la creación de videos a partir de los materiales que ya tengo, cuidando ritmo y formato para que resulten entretenidos —ese es el objetivo principal. Requiero: • Ajustar y sincronizar la duración de cada clip según las plataformas sociales más comunes. • Incorporar textos y elementos gráficos que refuercen el tono divertido. • Entregar archivos finales en formato MP4 optimizados para YouTube (1080 × 1920 y 1080 × 1080). Valoraré experiencia previa en edición de animación 2D, dominio de herramientas como After Effects o Premiere y buen criterio para colores, efectos y transiciones que reten­gan la atención. Comparte un breve portafolio de trabajos similares y el plazo estimado para cada video.

proposal.body:
¡Hola EMPRESA SOCIAL DEL ESTADO SAN SEBASTIAN DE LA PLATA (La Plata)! 👋 Revisé la solicitud exacta de **"🏛️ [Circular 188-2026] EMPRESA SOCIAL DEL ESTADO SAN SEBASTIAN DE LA PLATA (La Plata) — PRESTACION DE SERVICIOS"** y cumplo con los requisitos para iniciar de inmediato.

Realizo **bioconstrucción en guadua, muro tendinoso con botellas y vidrio, todo tipo de cubiertas y estructuras en metal/soldadura, café especial borbón rosado, murales artísticos, modelado 3D en Blender y planos**.

📲 Contacto directo en San Agustín, Huila (Colombia): **+57 322 273 9034**.

opportunities.title: Expertos en Prospección y Llamada en Frío para Captación de Cliente...
opportunities.description: Buscamos comerciales altamente motivados y con experiencia en prospección y llamada en frío para identificar y captar nuevos clientes interesados en servicios de diseño y desarrollo web. El objetivo principal es generar leads cualificados y programar reuniones o demostraciones para nuestro equipo de ventas. Responsabilidades: Realizar llamadas en frío a empresas y contactos potenciales. Identificar las necesidades de los clientes en relación con páginas web. Presentar de manera efectiva nuestros servicios de diseño y desarrollo web. Calificar leads y gestionar la base de datos de prospectos. Programar citas y reuniones para el equipo de ventas. Mantener un registro detallado de todas las interacciones y resultados. Requisitos: Experiencia comprobada en ventas, prospección telefónica y cold calling. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación verbal y persuasión. Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma y orientada a resultados. Conocimiento básico sobre el funcionamiento y la importancia de las páginas web para negocios. Habilidad para manejar objeciones y cerrar citas. Este es un rol continuo con un enfoque en el crecimiento de nuestra cartera de clientes. Buscamos profesionales comprometidos con el éxito a largo plazo. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Televentas Tiempo requerido: Más de 20 horas

opportunities.title: Se busca Jefe de Equipo Comercial Experto en Ventas de Páginas Web
opportunities.description: Estamos buscando un Jefe de Equipo Comercial altamente motivado y con experiencia para liderar nuestro equipo de ventas. El objetivo principal de este rol será la captación de nuevos clientes interesados en el desarrollo de páginas web y soluciones digitales. Responsabilidades clave: Liderar, motivar y capacitar a un equipo de ventas para alcanzar y superar los objetivos. Desarrollar e implementar estrategias de ventas efectivas para la adquisición de clientes. Identificar y contactar a potenciales clientes, presentando nuestras soluciones de diseño y desarrollo web. Gestionar el ciclo completo de ventas, desde la prospección hasta el cierre. Realizar seguimiento de las métricas de rendimiento del equipo y reportar resultados. Requisitos: Experiencia comprobada en ventas y liderazgo de equipos comerciales. Conocimiento del mercado de desarrollo web y marketing digital. opportunities.title: Dynamics 365 CRM Systems Analyst
opportunities.description: Dynamics 365 CRM Systems Analyst Position Summary The CRM Systems Analyst is responsible for the administration, support, enhancement, and reporting of the organization's CRM platform. This role serves as the bridge between business users and technical teams, partnering across departments to ensure CRM data integrity, efficient business processes, meaningful reporting, reliable system integrations, and solutions that support organization -wide needs. The ideal candidate combines strong CRM administration skills with data management, reporting, and technical aptitude. They should be comfortable troubleshooting issues, working with APIs and integrations, building Power BI reports, collaborating with stakeholders across departments, and helping users maximize the value of business applications. While the role is currently focused on Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform, the successful candidate must be adaptable, curious, and willing to learn new technologies as organizational needs evolve, including the potential migration to a different CRM platform in the future. Key Responsibilities CRM Administration Administer, maintain, and optimize the organization's CRM platform and related business applications. Manage user accounts, security roles, permissions, and access requests. Configure forms, views, dashboards, workflows, and business process automations. Monitor system performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Coordinate testing, deployment, and validation of system enhancements. Data Management & Quality Manage data imports, exports, cleansing, and deduplication efforts. Maintain data quality standards, integrity, and governance practices. Investigate and resolve data-related issues. Perform data audits and recommend process improvements. Document data structures, processes, and procedures. Reporting & Analytics Develop and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and data visualizations. Create recurring and ad hoc reports for business stakeholders. Analyze CRM and operational data to identify trends and opportunities. Support leadership with meaningful metrics and performance reporting. Integrations & Technical Support Monitor and support integrations between CRM and other business systems. Assist in troubleshooting API, data synchronization, and automation issues. Work with software vendors, consultants, and developers to resolve technical challenges. Support Power Automate workflows and other low-code automation solutions. Assist with testing and validating integration changes. User Support & Training Serve as the primary point of contact for CRM user support. Investigate and resolve user issues and system requests. Develop documentation, training materials, and best practices. Conduct user training and onboarding sessions. Gather and prioritize enhancement requests from business stakeholders. Continuous Improvement Identify opportunities to improve business processes through technology. Stay current with CRM, reporting, automation, and data management trends. Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and future platform evaluations. Assist with platform migrations and organizational technology initiatives as needed. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in information systems, Business, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience. 3+ years of experience administering a CRM or business application platform. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM systems. Experience creating reports and dashboards using Power BI or similar analytics tools. Understanding of data management, data quality, and reporting concepts. Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and data exchange processes. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and customer service skills. Demonstrated ability and willingness to learn new systems, technologies, and business applications. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform. Experience with Dataverse, Power Apps, and Power Automate. Knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts. Experience supporting cloud-based business applications. Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, or related certifications. Experience working in a membership, association, nonprofit, or customerfocused environment. Desired Candidate Profile We are looking for a technically curious individual who enjoys learning new systems and solving business problems through technology. The ideal candidate is comfortable working at the intersection of business and technology, supporting users while continuously improving processes, data quality, reporting, and system capabilities. Because CRM systems touch many areas of the organization, crossdepartmental collaboration is essential to understanding business needs, aligning solutions, and driving successful adoption. Success in this role requires adaptability and a willingness to learn. While the position is currently focused on Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform, we recognize that technology platforms evolve over time. The successful candidate will be excited to learn new applications, tools, and CRM platforms as organizational needs change and will play an active role in evaluating, implementing, and supporting future systems. We value problem-solving, initiative, and a growth mindset more than expertise in any single software platform. The ideal candidate sees technology skills as transferable and welcomes opportunities to expand their knowledge and contribute to organizational success regardless of the underlying platform. Success in This Role The successful candidate will: Maintain a reliable, secure, and well-governed CRM environment. Ensure high levels of data quality and user adoption. Deliver meaningful reporting and business insights through Power BI. Effectively support CRM users and business stakeholders. Help improve organizational efficiency through automation and process improvements. Adapt to evolving technologies and successfully support future platform changes and migrations. Estimated Role Focus: 40% CRM Administration & User Support 30% Data Management & Reporting 15% Process Improvement & Automation 15% Integrations & Technical Support This role is ideal for someone who is more technical than a traditional CRM administrator but less specialized than a software developer, with a strong interest in business systems, data, reporting, and continuous learning. ACSESS is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. We value diversity and inclusion and are committed to creating a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination. Bachelor's (Required) Experience: Microsoft 365 Dynamics CRM: 3 years (Required) Protech Association Management Software (AMS): 2 years (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Fitchburg, WI 53711

opportunities.title: E-Commerce Growth & Meta Ads Specialist for Celvane (December 2026 Sale — ₹10k–₹30k Bidding + 10% Revenue Share)
opportunities.description: Project Overview: Our storefront, product catalog, and WhatsApp sales integrations for Celvane are live and ready. We are looking for an experienced D2C Performance Marketer / E-Commerce Growth Specialist to drive ₹2,00,000 to ₹3,00,000 in gross sales during December 2026 through our upcoming Black Friday / Cyber Week Sale and Year-End Clearance Sale campaigns. Campaign Scope & Deliverables: 1. December Sale Funnel & Offer Execution: - Plan and execute high-converting ad campaigns for our December Sale events. - Set up and manage Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram Sales/Conversion campaigns) alongside WhatsApp retargeting/broadcast flows to maximize checkout conversions. - Optimize ad creatives, hooks, and audience targeting to maintain a profitable Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). 2. Sales Target & Tracking: - Target Gross Revenue: ₹2,00,000 to ₹3,00,000 in December 2026. - Provide transparent daily/weekly reporting (Ad Spend, ROAS, Orders Generated, and Net Delivered Sales). Compensation Structure (Hybrid Model — Fixed Bid + 10% Revenue Share): - Fixed Base Bidding Range: ₹10,000 to ₹30,000 (Please place your bid strictly within this ₹10k–₹30k range, split into 2 milestones). * Milestone 1 (50%): Campaign architecture, pixel/conversion verification, creative launch, and initial traction. * Milestone 2 (50%): Mid-campaign scaling, optimization, and full December sale execution. - Guaranteed 10% Revenue Share: On top of your fixed bid, you will receive a 10% commission on total net delivered sales (e.g., ₹30,000 extra payout upon achieving ₹3,00,000 in delivered sales). Bidding Requirements (Strict): - Only bid if you accept this Hybrid Model (₹10,000–₹30,000 fixed bid + 10% revenue share on realized sales). - Share verified case studies or dashboard screenshots of Indian D2C fashion/lifestyle ad accounts you have scaled. - State your recommended daily ad spend budget to achieve ₹3,00,000 in December sales.

opportunities.title: Detailed 3D Model of Prosthetic Leg
opportunities.description: I need a highly detailed 3D model of a human-style prosthetic leg, specifically designed for 3D printing a physical prototype. Requirements: - Realistic model that matches the existing structure. - Realistic 3D modeling of the images on the side to be 3D similar to the AI images shown. - Textures and markings to mimic a real wooden leg. - Output 3D printable STL files (2). Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proficiency in 3D modeling software (e.g., Blender, Maya, ZBrush). - Experience in creating intricate, realistic 3D models. - Familiarity with 3D printing requirements and constraints. NOTE: This model will be used to create a decorative outer shell of an existing prosthetic leg. Nothing in this design will be weight bearing. I can provide photos that can be used for photogrammetry for the basic shape of both parts (upper and lower leg). The inside of the leg is not important at the moment. The upper and lower ends can be closed off. The lower leg is supposed to represent a "griffin foot" atop a cannon ball. The cannon ball can be rough textured as if it is from the 19th century. The fur above the griffin foot needs to be better than the original.

Requirements: - Realistic model that matches the existing structure. - Realistic 3D modeling of the images on the side to be 3D similar to the AI images shown. - Textures and markings to mimic a real wooden leg. - Output 3D printable STL files (2). Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proficiency in 3D modeling software (e.g., Blender, Maya, ZBrush). - Experience in creating intricate, realistic 3D models. - Familiarity with 3D printing requirements and constraints. NOTE: This model will be used to create a decorative outer shell of an existing prosthetic leg. Nothing in this design will be weight bearing. I can provide photos that can be used for photogrammetry for the basic shape of both parts (upper and lower leg). The inside of the leg is not important at the moment. The upper and lower ends can be closed off. The lower leg is supposed to represent a "griffin foot" atop a cannon ball. The cannon ball can be rough textured as if it is from the 19th century. The fur above the griffin foot needs to be better than the original."

opportunities.title: Redistribución Vivienda con Metrajes
opportunities.description: Quiero replantear por completo la distribución de mi vivienda y recibir planos acotados que muestren los metros exactos de cada pared. Necesito, al menos, dos propuestas distintas que incluyan dos baños, uno de ellos un baño completo con ducha. Prioridades clave • Aprovechar al máximo el espacio de almacenamiento, dando especial importancia a armarios amplios dentro de los dormitorios. • Mantener un flujo cómodo entre las zonas comunes sin sacrificar la capacidad de guardarropa. • Optimizar la ubicación de instalaciones para que la reforma sea viable técnica y económicamente. Entregables esperados 1. Plano actual digitalizado (si fuera necesario, puedo facilitar boceto y medidas básicas). 2. Dos o más opciones de nueva distribución en formato CAD o equivalente, cada una: – Acotada con metros lineales de todas las paredes. – Con indicación clara de los dos baños y sus piezas sanitarias. – Marcando la posición y tamaño de los armarios en dormitorios. 3. Breve memoria descriptiva que justifique las decisiones de diseño y las ventajas de cada opción. 4. Archivo editable (DWG, DXF o similar) y PDF listo para imprimir. Valoro que el profesional tenga experiencia en interiorismo residencial, manejo fluido de AutoCAD/Revit o herramienta similar y buen criterio para soluciones de almacenaje inteligentes. Estoy disponible para resolver dudas y aportar planos, fotos o restricciones técnicas adicionales que faciliten el trabajo.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40832263, publicado hace 39 minutos (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: EUR 8 - 30.

opportunities.title: Nextverse Digital Agency Website
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a sleek, future-proof website for my agency, Nextverse Digital, based in Casablanca. The whole experience must be in French and laser-focused on turning visitors into qualified client inquiries. Scope of the build • Pages: Home, Services, Portfolio and Contact • Primary CTA: a WhatsApp “Click-to-Chat” so prospects can reach me instantly • Platform: I’m happy with either WordPress (Elementor, Gutenberg, etc.) or a React stack—as long as the site loads fast, is fully responsive and is easy for me to update later • Essentials: clean UI, lightweight code, Core Web Vitals in the green, basic on-page SEO (title tags, meta descriptions, schema where relevant) Deliverables 1. Complete, documented source code (theme/components, assets, README) 2. Two revision rounds after the first full draft 3. Deployment support to my hosting so the site goes live without hiccups If this sounds like your kind of project, show me a couple of relevant launches you’ve handled and tell me how you would approach the WhatsApp integration and performance tuning. I’m ready to get started right away.

opportunities.title: Senior Game Developer / Unity & Unreal Engine Developer
opportunities.description: We are seeking an experienced Game Developer to design, develop, and deliver engaging, high-quality games across mobile, PC, and virtual reality platforms. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Unity and Unreal Engine, gameplay programming, 2D/3D development, mobile optimization, and interactive game mechanics. You will work on different game-development projects, ranging from casual mobile games and multiplayer experiences to immersive VR sports games and advanced 3D environments. You should be comfortable taking a project from concept and prototyping through development, testing, optimization, and final deployment. Key Responsibilities 1. Game Design & Development - Design, develop, and implement complete game mechanics and gameplay systems. - Build engaging 2D and 3D games for mobile, desktop, and VR platforms. - Develop player controls, character movement, physics, animations, and interactive environments. - Create prototypes and transform concepts into fully playable experiences. - Improve gameplay quality, performance, and user experience. 2. Unity & Unreal Engine Development - Develop games using Unity and C#. - Build 3D gameplay systems using Unreal Engine and C++ or Blueprints. - Implement game logic, UI systems, animation controllers, and physics interactions. - Integrate third-party SDKs, plugins, APIs, and game services. - Debug, maintain, and optimize existing game projects. 3. Mobile Game Development - Develop and deploy games for iOS and Android. - Implement mobile-friendly controls, menus, animations, and gameplay systems. - Optimize graphics, loading times, memory usage, and device performance. - Integrate mobile SDKs, analytics, in-app purchases, and multiplayer services where required. - Prepare builds for App Store and Google Play submission. 4. Multiplayer & Online Game Systems - Implement real-time multiplayer functionality. - Develop matchmaking, player sessions, synchronization, and networking systems. - Build competitive gameplay, including head-to-head trivia and party games. - Integrate multiplayer SDKs such as Skillz or other suitable networking solutions. - Implement player progression, leaderboards, and in-game economies. 5. VR, AR & Mixed Reality - Develop immersive VR games and interactive sports experiences. - Implement VR interactions, physics, player movement, and object manipulation. - Build AR and mixed-reality experiences. - Integrate VR hardware and platform-specific SDKs. - Improve immersion, responsiveness, and performance. 6. 3D Modeling, Animation & Visual Effects - Create and integrate 3D assets using Blender and other modeling tools. - Develop environments, characters, objects, and game assets. - Implement animations, lighting, shaders, visual effects, and post-processing. - Optimize models, textures, and rendering pipelines. 7. Game Systems & Special Features - Develop idle gameplay, progression, crafting, gathering, and resource-management systems. - Implement RPG and MMORPG mechanics. - Build cooking, restaurant-management, trivia, and time-management gameplay. - Develop interactive architectural environments and digital-twin experiences. - Implement in-game rewards, player economies, and monetization systems. 8. AI-Assisted Development - Use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools when appropriate. - Accelerate prototyping, debugging, code generation, and development workflows. - Review and validate AI-generated code before integration. - Maintain code quality, architecture, and performance standards. 9. Testing, Optimization & Deployment - Identify and resolve gameplay bugs and technical issues. - Perform functional, compatibility, and performance testing. - Optimize game performance across supported devices and platforms. - Prepare release builds and deployment documentation. - Maintain and improve games after launch. Required Technical Skills Category Technologies Game engines Unity, Unreal Engine 5 Programming C#, C++, Blueprint Mobile iOS, Android 2D/3D Blender, 3D modeling, animation VR/AR Oculus/Meta Quest, OpenXR, AR SDKs Multiplayer Skillz SDK, Photon, Unity Netcode Graphics Shaders, VFX, lighting, rendering Backend REST APIs, databases, multiplayer services AI tools Claude Code, OpenAI Codex Deployment App Store, Google Play, PC builds Qualifications - 3+ years of professional game-development experience preferred. - Strong experience with Unity or Unreal Engine. - Proficiency in C# or C++. - Experience developing and publishing mobile games. - Understanding of gameplay architecture, physics, animation, and optimization. - Experience with 2D/3D game development. - Ability to work independently and deliver projects on schedule. - Strong problem-solving and communication skills. - A portfolio demonstrating previously developed games is required. Preferred Qualifications - Experience with multiplayer and online game development. - Experience with VR/AR and Meta Quest applications. - Experience with MMORPG, RPG, idle, or competitive games. - Knowledge of AI-assisted coding workflows. - Experience with Skillz SDK or similar competitive gaming platforms. - Experience with Blender and complete 3D production workflows. Project Deliverables - Functional game prototype and playable builds. - Complete gameplay mechanics and integrated game systems. - Source code and project files. - Optimized assets, animations, and visual effects. - Mobile, desktop, or VR deployment builds, depending on project scope. - Testing documentation and technical handover. Compensation & Engagement - Engagement: Freelance, contract, or project-based. - Work arrangement: Remote. - Compensation: Negotiable based on experience and project scope. - Project duration: Varies by development requirements. - Applicants should provide their portfolio, relevant game-development experience, preferred engine, and estimated availability.

opportunities.title: ArchiCAD CAD/BIM Drafter – Luxury Residential Interiors (Remote | Long-Term Contract)
opportunities.description: We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented ArchiCAD CAD/BIM Drafter to join our team on a remote, long-term contract basis. The ideal candidate has extensive experience producing accurate, comprehensive construction documentation for high-end residential interior design projects, with particular expertise in custom millwork and cabinetry. This role requires someone who can work independently, follow established drafting standards, and collaborate effectively with our interior design team. Key Responsibilities - Develop complete interior construction drawing sets in ArchiCAD based on designer plans, markups, and redlines. - Prepare detailed floor plans, reflected ceiling plans (RCPs), interior elevations, and sections. - Produce precise millwork, custom cabinetry, and built-in furniture drawings. - Work within our existing ArchiCAD templates while maintaining consistent drafting quality, organization, and file-naming conventions. - Incorporate design revisions accurately and efficiently. - Coordinate with the design team to ensure drawings meet project requirements and deadlines. Required Qualifications - Advanced proficiency in ArchiCAD, with senior-level drafting experience. - Must be able to work in ArchiCAD 25 Solo and have an active personal software license. - Proven experience preparing complete interior construction documentation, not just 3D models or renderings. - Strong knowledge of interior detailing, cabinetry, millwork, and residential construction methods. - Excellent attention to detail and ability to interpret design drawings and redlines. - Strong written English communication skills for daily collaboration. - Ability to work independently and consistently meet deadlines. - Availability of 30–40 hours per week, including some overlap with US Eastern Time. Preferred Qualifications - Previous experience working on luxury residential interior design projects. - Familiarity with US residential construction documentation, building practices, and drafting standards. - Experience collaborating remotely with interior designers and architects. Contract Details - Location: Fully Remote - Employment Type: Independent Contractor (Hourly) - Contract Duration: Initial 3 months, with strong potential for long-term collaboration - Workload: 30–40 hours per week - Hourly Rate: $4–$15 USD, based on skills and experience - Selection Process: Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid drafting trial. How to Apply - Please include the following in your application: - A brief introduction highlighting your ArchiCAD experience and relevant interior drafting projects. - A portfolio featuring complete interior construction drawing sets, including plans, elevations, sections, and millwork details. Applications featuring only renderings or 3D models will not be considered. - Confirmation that you have access to ArchiCAD 25 Solo and hold your own license. - Your proposed hourly rate and weekly availability. - Your experience working on US residential interior projects, if applicable. Important: To confirm that you have read the job description carefully, begin your proposal with the exact phrase "ArchiCAD Interior design". Applications without a relevant construction drawing portfolio will not be considered. We look forward to working with a reliable, experienced drafter who values precision, consistency, and high-quality interior construction documentation.

opportunities.title: Android APK EncryptionTelegram BOT Expert
opportunities.description: Urgently Hiring – Android Encryption & Security Developer We are looking for an experienced Android Encryption & Application Security Developer for an existing encryption project. The project already has complete source code and project files. The developer must be capable of understanding the entire existing codebase, analysing its architecture, reconstructing the source code, and implementing new encryption and security solutions according to our requirements. Required Technical Skills 1. Java & Android Development * Strong knowledge of Java. * Android application architecture and source-code analysis. * Understanding of Android SDK, Gradle and build systems. * APK structure and DEX file analysis. 2. Python Development * Python scripting and automation. * Developing custom encryption and protection tools. * Integrating Python-based workflows with Android build processes. 3. Android Encryption & Protection * APK encryption and application protection. * DEX/classes.dex analysis and protection. * Custom encryption and decryption mechanisms. * Secure key management. * Code obfuscation and anti-tampering implementation. * Understanding Android application loading mechanisms. 4. Certificate & Signature Management * APK signing and signature verification. * Keystore and certificate management. * Android signing certificates and signing schemes (V1, V2, V3 and V4). * Understanding APK integrity and certificate validation. 5. Reverse Engineering & Source-Code Analysis * Ability to understand an existing complete source-code project. * Experience analysing APKs and application structures. * Reconstructing and modifying existing projects. * Identifying security vulnerabilities and fixing build issues. Project Responsibilities * Study and understand the complete existing project. * Analyse the existing encryption architecture. * Reconstruct and improve the source code according to requirements. * Develop and integrate a new encryption solution. * Implement reliable Android application protection. * Maintain application functionality after encryption. * Test APK compatibility, integrity and security. * Resolve legitimate Google Play Protect and antivirus false-positive issues. * Prepare a stable, properly signed and release-ready APK. Important Requirements * Must have previous practical experience in Android encryption and application security. * Must be comfortable working with an existing large source-code project. * Must understand both Java and Python. * Must be capable of independently analysing and solving complex technical issues. Preference: Developers with previous experience building Android APK protection, encryption, and security systems. Interested developers can share their previous work, GitHub profile, and relevant project experience

opportunities.title: AI Abattoir Management Automation
opportunities.description: AI GENERATION AI-Powered Abattoir Administration, Invoicing, Stock & Payment Management System Business: Buffalo Wings and Things Project: AI Generation Location: South Africa Preferred platform: n8n automation with a simple laptop-based management interface 1. Project Overview We want to develop an affordable, AI-powered administration system for our abattoir and meat sales business. The main objective is to automate invoicing, stock control, payment tracking and financial reporting while keeping the system simple enough for everyday use. The system must integrate WhatsApp communication with a central database that can be accessed and managed from a Windows laptop. 2. Stock and Inventory Management The system must include a stock management function directly linked to invoicing. Required functionality: * Stock will be entered manually using a laptop. * Each meat product must have its own stock balance, measured primarily in kilograms. * Products include rump, T-bone, biltong cuts, mince, boerewors, stew, shins and other meat products. * The user must be able to add new stock, adjust quantities and correct errors. * The system must automatically deduct the quantity sold from stock when an invoice is finalized. * Stock must not be deducted twice if an invoice is edited or processed again. * Cancelled or corrected invoices must update stock appropriately. * The system should display current stock balances and identify products running low. * Every stock movement must be recorded for traceability. Example: * Starting rump stock: 50 kg * Customer purchases: 8 kg * Invoice generated and finalized: 8 kg * Remaining rump stock: 42 kg The system must automatically update the available rump stock to 42 kg. 3. Automated Invoice Generation The system must generate professional PDF invoices for meat sales. Required functionality: * Receive completed order details through WhatsApp or manual entry. * Use AI to read photographs of handwritten order sheets. * Extract product descriptions, actual final weights and quantities. * Apply prices from an editable product price list. * Calculate invoice totals automatically. * Generate unique invoice reference numbers. * Include customer information, business details and banking details. * Produce a professional branded PDF invoice. * Allow the owner to review and approve invoices before sending them. * Link finalized invoices directly to stock deductions. 4. WhatsApp Integration The business currently uses a WhatsApp group containing the owner, his father and an abattoir worker. The system should work alongside this existing arrangement. Required functionality: * Receive completed meat order information. * Process typed messages and photographs of handwritten order sheets. * Prepare invoices based on the supplied information. * Use a dedicated WhatsApp Business number for AI Generation. * Receive customer proof-of-payment documents through WhatsApp. * Allow the owner to request invoice and payment reports through WhatsApp. The developer must confirm which parts of the existing WhatsApp group workflow can be integrated using supported WhatsApp Business APIs. 5. Payment Tracking and Proof of Payment The system must maintain an accurate record of outstanding customer payments. Required functionality: * Receive proof-of-payment documents. * Read payment amounts, dates and references. * Match payment proofs to existing invoices. * Identify fully paid, partially paid, unpaid and overdue invoices. * Calculate outstanding balances. * Allow manual confirmation of payments received in the FNB bank account. * Distinguish between proof of payment received and actual bank payment confirmed. * Generate reports of customers with outstanding balances. The system should not mark an invoice as paid solely because a customer submitted proof of payment. 6. Financial Reports and Administration The owner must be able to request simple reports, including: * Total sales for a selected day, week or month. * Total outstanding customer balances. * Paid and unpaid invoice lists. * Sales by meat product. * Current stock quantities. * Stock sold during a selected period. * Monthly invoicing and payment summaries. Example questions: “Show me all unpaid invoices.” “How many kilograms of rump do we have left?” “What was our total sales value this month?” “Show me all customers who still owe money.” 7. Laptop Management Interface The system must have a simple interface accessible from a Windows laptop. The user must be able to: * Manually capture new stock. * View and edit stock balances. * Maintain product prices. * Create and review invoices. * Search customer records. * View payment statuses. * Generate reports. The interface should be straightforward and require minimal technical knowledge. 8. Preferred Technology and Budget We prefer an affordable solution using: * n8n Community Edition for automation. * Google Sheets or a suitable database for initial recordkeeping. * AI document reading for handwritten orders and payment proofs. * PDF invoice generation. * Official WhatsApp Business integration. The system should be modular so that additional functionality can be introduced later. Budget preference: * Keep ongoing costs as close to R0 as reasonably possible. * Ideally remain below R300–R500 per month once fully operational. * Development costs should be quoted separately from monthly running costs. 9. Security, Ownership and Reliability * The business must own its database, customer information and workflows. * The owner must have full administrative access. * Customer and financial information must be protected. * The system must include regular backups. * Stock deductions and invoice updates must be reliable and auditable. * The developer must provide documentation and basic training. * The solution must account for South African data privacy requirements, including POPIA. 10. Expected Final Result We want a working AI-powered administration assistant that connects four essential business activities: STOCK → INVOICING → PAYMENTS → REPORTING The owner manually enters available stock on the laptop. When meat is sold, the system creates an invoice and automatically updates stock quantities. Customers submit payment proofs through WhatsApp, and the AI matches these to invoices. The owner can then monitor sales, inventory and outstanding customer payments from one central system. The objective is to reduce manual administration, prevent stock discrepancies, improve payment tracking and make the abattoir easier to manage as the business grows. Please provide a quotation for developing this system, including the estimated once-off development cost, monthly operating costs, implementation time and ongoing support.

opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional con experiencia comprobada en diseño CAD 3D para manufactura e integración electromecánica de dispositivos portátiles. El objetivo principal es desarrollar el modelo 3D definitivo de un dispositivo portátil, telescópico de baja potencia, listo para impresión 3D y futura inyección de plástico. Adicionalmente, se requiere ensamblar un primer prototipo funcional de dicho dispositivo. Los detalles funcionales específicos, la arquitectura mecánica y la aplicación del producto se entregarán únicamente tras la firma de un acuerdo de confidencialidad (NDA). Es indispensable que el candidato esté ubicado en la ciudad de Bogotá. Se valorará el dominio avanzado de software CAD 3D como SolidWorks, Fusion 360 o Inventor, así como experiencia en el diseño de mecanismos móviles. El contrato será de obra por encargo con cesión del 100% de los derechos de propiedad intelectual. Categoría: Ingeniería y Arquitectura Subcategoría: Modelador en 3D ¿Qué necesitas?: Modelado 3D de varios objetos, desde cero

opportunities.title: Industrial Electronic Enclosure Design
opportunities.description: I have an existing PCB and component layout that needs a purpose-built enclosure for use in an industrial or workshop setting. The housing must look professional yet stay compact, with precise mounting bosses, connector cut-outs, and generous internal clearances so nothing clashes during assembly. Because the unit will live near machinery, please integrate sensible protection from dust and occasional splashes—think gasketed seams, covered vents, or similar approaches that you have proven in past projects. Your workflow can be in SolidWorks or Fusion 360 as long as you supply: • The fully editable native 3D model • Neutral STEP and STL exports for rapid prototyping • Manufacturing-ready drawings with tolerances, material call-outs, and any fastening details If you have handled small-run plastics, CNC-machined housings, or other enclosure types before, include that in your reply along with portfolio links, your estimated cost, and a realistic turnaround time. I am ready to move quickly once we confirm scope and milestones.

opportunities.title: Program Arduino Stepper Automation
opportunities.description: I’m building a custom automated mechanism driven by an Arduino Uno and NEMA-series stepper motors—the motion hardware is already selected and wired up, much like a stripped-down 3D-printer axis. What I still need is a clean, reliable sketch that will run the show. Your main task is to write the Arduino code that orchestrates the steppers, limit switches, and a simple control panel (start/stop buttons plus a status LED). The motion routine is not a standard “print” or “pick-and-place” cycle; it follows a sequence I will share in detail once we get started, but think of it as a repeatable multi-position move with dwell times and homing on power-up. Because the mechanism borrows components from the 3D-printing world, familiarity with libraries such as AccelStepper, GRBL-style movement, or Marlin-style homing logic will be useful. The mechanical side, wiring, and driver selection are covered—I just need tight, well-commented firmware that: • Homes safely on both axes using limit switches • Executes the positional routine from a single button press • Allows easy tweaking of speeds, micro-steps, and dwell delays • Handles basic fault conditions (stall, missed step, emergency stop) Please deliver the fully documented .ino file along with any additional header libraries or pin-mapping notes so I can flash and test immediately. If you can suggest improvements to motion smoothness or code efficiency, that’s a plus. Let me know your turnaround and any clarifying questions, and we’ll get this machine moving.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40832134, publicado hace 2 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 100 - 400.

opportunities.title: Riyadh Retail AI Automation Report
opportunities.description: I need a concise yet actionable report that shows retail and e-commerce companies in Riyadh exactly how artificial intelligence and automation can replace labour-intensive processes and cut operating costs. The focus is strictly on this industry; I’m not looking for coverage of government services or other private-sector segments. The document should move from problem identification to concrete, data-backed solutions. Map the current retail and e-commerce workflow in Riyadh, pinpoint high-friction manual tasks (stock reconciliation, order routing, customer service, pricing updates, etc.) and recommend the best-fit AI tools—think RPA bots, computer-vision shelf scanning, conversational AI, demand-forecasting engines—along with projected savings and an implementation timeline. Deliverables: • 15-20 page PDF report formatted for executive review • Process maps highlighting manual vs. automated steps • Cost–benefit analysis with local salary and tech pricing assumptions • Roadmap with quick wins (≤3 months) and longer-term roll-outs (up to 18 months) • Brief appendix listing Riyadh-based vendors, regulations, and relevant case studies Acceptance criteria: each recommendation must state estimated hours saved per month and expected ROI within the first year. If you have experience drafting similar automation assessments for retail or e-commerce, especially in GCC markets, I’d love to see a sample outline or excerpt when you bid.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40832091, publicado hace 3 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 750 - 1,250.

opportunities.title: AI Voice Sales Agent Automation
opportunities.description: I want to launch an AI-driven voice agent that can handle both inbound and outbound sales calls from start to finish. Its core job is to qualify every caller, following a scripted set of questions that uncover their needs, budget, and decision timeline. As it speaks, the agent must capture the prospect’s name, phone, email, and company details, then push that data directly into my CRM. When the lead meets the preset criteria, the agent should automatically book a time on my sales team’s calendar and send the prospect a confirmation email or SMS. Key deliverables • Production-ready voice agent capable of natural, human-like conversations • Workflow to ask qualifying questions, collect contact details, and schedule meetings • Real-time CRM integration and calendar booking automation • Dashboard or logs so I can review call recordings, transcripts, and lead data • Clear hand-off logic for calls the bot cannot handle Please attach a detailed project proposal outlining your technical approach, tools or APIs you intend to use (e.g., Twilio, Dialogflow, Azure, Amazon Connect, GPT, or similar), timeline, and any previous examples of live voice-automation you have built. I’ll use that proposal to assess fit and move quickly into implementation.

opportunities.title: Remote Retail Tech Project Coordinator
opportunities.description: Job Description: Project Coordinator and Personal Assistant (Part-Time Role) Position Type: Part-Time (hourly), freelance Location: Remote (working from home, accommodating US hours as needed) About Us We are a retail tech community and innovation hub connecting startups, retailers, brands, and innovators. Founded in 2013, we run research and industry reports, host events including create opportunities for collaboration across the global retail-tech ecosystem. We are seeking an organized and proactive Project Manager and Personal Assistant to oversee projects, manage operations, and ensure seamless coordination with our partners in Israel and the US. This is a part-time (50%) role, ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a dynamic environment and can work effectively across time zones. Key Responsibilities Project Management Oversee ongoing projects, including events, research, workshops, and collaborations with local and global partners. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring tasks are completed on schedule and to a high standard. Manage schedules, timelines, and resources for multiple projects simultaneously. Create and oversee grant applications, proposals, and other project-related documentation. Operational Management & Personal Assistant Manage the day-to-day operations of the company, ensuring smooth workflows and efficient processes. Book meetings, organize schedules, and manage client and partner communications. Write project proposals and reports, ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Support inbox management, meeting notes and summaries, follow-ups, travel arrangements, and other personal assignments as needed. Marketing, Events & Community Manage the marketing activities of the company, either directly or via subcontractors working with the company. Define targets and KPIs for the marketing activity and make sure they are met. Manage the company's websites and other digital assets. Create and send a monthly or bi-monthly newsletter as needed. Manage the promotion calendar, which includes channels such as social media, WhatsApp groups, blog etc. Manage the marketing and promotion of events. Help with event production, content, and sponsorship sales. Research potential new leads and manage ongoing outreach to build sales opportunities. Build a community management strategy and execute it, either directly or via subcontractors working with the company. Requirements Highly Organized: Exceptional multitasker with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage tasks and people who don't directly report to you. Digital Proficiency: Comfortable using tools like HubSpot, WordPress, Canva, and Google Workspace, and fluent with AI tools (meeting assistants, LLMs) for drafting, research and follow-ups. Experience with other SaaS tools is a plus. People-Oriented: A natural relationship builder who enjoys engaging with clients, partners, and team members. Proactive Problem-Solver: Self-motivated and resourceful, with the ability to identify challenges and find solutions independently. Communicator: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, Hebrew is an advantage. Flexible: Willing to work US hours as needed. Bonus Skills Experience in sales development or leading sales processes. Interest and knowledge of the tech or retail industries. Details Role Type: Part-time, ~20 hours per week. Work Environment: Fully remote, working US hours as needed. Reporting to: CEO Selection process: 1.Assessment 2.Interview

opportunities.title: Complete Flat Interior Design
opportunities.description: I’m ready to give my entire flat a cohesive, professional look and need a designer who can take the project from concept to final visuals. Every space is on the table—living room, all bedrooms, kitchen, bathrooms, balcony, and the entry area—so the plan must flow naturally from one room to the next. For the bedrooms I lean toward a modern, simple aesthetic: clean lines, light tones, and practical storage that keeps clutter out of sight. I’m open to complementary moods for the remaining areas as long as the overall palette and materials feel consistent and contemporary. You’re free to use the tools you’re most comfortable with—AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max, Revit, or similar—as long as the deliverables arrive in a format I can review easily. Deliverables I expect • Mood boards and color/material palettes for each room • Scaled floor plans with furniture layout • 3D renders or walkthroughs that clearly convey the design intent • A concise shopping/specification list covering key finishes, lighting, and furniture pieces I’ll provide current floor plans and measurements once we start; you’ll guide me on any additional details you need. I value clear communication and phased checkpoints so adjustments can happen early rather than late. If this sounds like your kind of project, let’s talk timelines and get started.

opportunities.title: Design 3D Print-Ready Model
opportunities.description: I need a detailed 3D model prepared specifically for 3D printing. Once finished, the file should be ready to slice with no additional cleanup or repairs on my end—think watertight geometry, correct wall thickness, and properly oriented normals. Because I haven’t attached photos, sketches, or measurements yet, I’ll provide you with all the reference material and dimensions as soon as we connect. From there, you can recommend the best CAD workflow (Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Blender, or any package you’re comfortable with) and flag any design constraints that could affect printability. Deliverables • Print-ready STL (or OBJ if preferred) • Original editable file from your software of choice I’ll review the model by test-slicing it in Cura; if it slices cleanly without errors and the dimensions match the spec sheet, the job is complete.

opportunities.title: Zen Meditation Corner Design
opportunities.description: I need a thoughtful Zen-style plan for one specific area—my small courtyard—which I want to turn into a quiet space for relaxing and meditation. The footprint is modest, so every stone, plant, and water element has to earn its place and work together to create flow, balance, and a sense of calm. The job is design-only (no installation), but I do need it fast. If we can move from concept to final drawings within the next few days, that would be ideal. Deliverables • Scaled layout showing hardscape, planting zones, and focal points • Plant and material palette with local sourcing notes • Simple 3D or isometric visual to illustrate atmosphere • Brief maintenance notes so I can keep the space looking pristine All files should be delivered in PDF and an editable format (DWG, SketchUp, or similar).

opportunities.title: Remote Structural CAD Support
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a reliable CAD technician who can slot into my workflow on a long-term, part-time basis. Most of my projects involve residential and light-commercial buildings, so you’ll spend your time translating my engineering mark-ups into clean, build-ready drawings. You’ll normally receive a marked-up PDF set and the architect’s plans (PDF or DWG). From there, I need you to generate the structural package in AutoCAD—or an equivalent CAD platform if you prefer—following my layering, linetype, and title-block standards. Typical deliverables • Floor and roof framing plans • Foundation plans with all relevant details • Structural sections, schedules, and connection details Turnaround on a small house is usually three to four working days; larger light-commercial jobs can stretch to a week. Clear, consistent communication is vital: before you start, confirm any missing information; during the job, flag clashes or constructability concerns; on submission, include a PDF set plus the editable CAD file. I anticipate 10–15 hours of work most weeks, with flexibility to scale up when larger projects hit. Sound like a fit? Tell me about your relevant projects, preferred CAD tools, and typical turnaround time.

opportunities.title: Local SEO, Google Business Profile (GBP) Optimization & Website Development Specialist -- 2
opportunities.description: Job Title: Local SEO, Google Business Profile (GBP) Optimization & Website Development Specialist Project Overview I am looking for an experienced Local SEO and Web Development Specialist to completely optimize, manage, and improve my Google Business Profile (GBP) and build a professional, SEO-friendly business website. Google Business Profile: https://share.google/OIFIwM7YPr2bRhxoo The goal is to rank my business among the Top 3 local search results and Google Maps listings, establish a strong online presence, outperform competitors, and generate consistent customer inquiries and leads through both Google Search and the website. Scope of Work & Deliverables 1. Full Google Business Profile Audit & Optimization Audit my current Google Business Profile and compare it against the top 3 local competitors. Optimize the business description, primary and secondary categories, services, and attributes using high-intent local keywords. Ensure Name, Address, and Phone Number (NAP) consistency across the profile. Identify opportunities to improve local search visibility and Google Maps rankings. 2. Website Design & Development Build a modern, professional, mobile-friendly, and SEO-optimized business website. Website requirements: Professional and visually appealing UI/UX design. Fully responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop. SEO-friendly website structure and URLs. Integration with Google Business Profile and Google Maps. Contact forms to generate customer inquiries and leads. Click-to-call and WhatsApp integration. Dedicated service pages optimized for local search keywords. Location-specific landing pages where relevant. Fast loading speed and Core Web Vitals optimization. Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console integration. Proper technical SEO, XML sitemap, robots.txt, and schema markup. SSL certificate and basic website security. Social media integration. Additional expectations: Website content should be optimized for both search engines and potential customers. Clear calls to action (CTAs) to encourage visitors to call, message, or submit inquiries. Basic website maintenance and technical support. 3. Visual Branding & Content Creation Design and upload high-converting branded visual assets, including cover photos, logo optimization, and service graphics. Optimize photos before uploading them. Create and publish engaging weekly Google Posts (offers, updates, and service highlights) for the first month. Maintain consistent branding across the website and Google Business Profile. 4. Local SEO & Google Maps Ranking Build high-authority local citations and directory listings relevant to my industry and location. Optimize the Q&A section with relevant customer questions and answers. Conduct local keyword research and competitor analysis. Develop a local SEO strategy to improve organic rankings and Google Maps visibility. Optimize website pages for relevant local search terms. Build relevant, high-quality backlinks using white-hat SEO techniques. 5. Review Growth Strategy Set up a simple system, QR code, or template to help collect more genuine customer reviews. Write professional, SEO-friendly responses to existing and new customer reviews. Develop a strategy to consistently increase authentic customer feedback. No fake reviews or incentivized review manipulation. 6. Reporting & Performance Tracking Provide a clear before-and-after ranking report using Local Search Grid/Heat Map tools. Track Google Business Profile views, website clicks, calls, and direction requests. Track website traffic, keyword rankings, organic clicks, and conversions. Provide monthly performance reports with actionable recommendations. Requirements for Applicants Proven track record of ranking Google Business Profiles in the Top 3 Local Map Pack. Please share 2–3 recent case studies or screenshots demonstrating previous results. Strong knowledge of Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, and Google Maps ranking factors. Experience in website design and development, including WordPress or modern web technologies. Knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, schema markup, and website speed optimization. Strong graphic design skills (Canva/Photoshop) for creating professional GBP posts and banners. Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and local ranking tracking tools. Strict adherence to Google's white-hat guidelines. No fake reviews, keyword stuffing in business names, or spam tactics that could risk profile suspension. Expected Outcome I am looking for someone who can handle both the website and local SEO requirements end-to-end. The primary objective is to: Rank the Google Business Profile among the Top 3 local Map Pack results for relevant keywords. Build a professional website that attracts visitors and converts them into customers. Improve organic visibility on Google Search. Generate consistent calls, WhatsApp messages, and customer inquiries. Establish a strong and sustainable online presence. Please include your portfolio, previous SEO results, website development examples, proposed strategy, estimated timeline, and pricing when applying. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1U83CGb1xq8dbxPomR0KMHMIa63FoHCTt2E9QTe4obWw/edit?usp=sharing

Scope of Work & Deliverables 1. Full Google Business Profile Audit & Optimization Audit my current Google Business Profile and compare it against the top 3 local competitors. Optimize the business description, primary and secondary categories, services, and attributes using high-intent local keywords. Ensure Name, Address, and Phone Number (NAP) consistency across the profile. Identify opportunities to improve local search visibility and Google Maps rankings. 2. Website Design & Development Build a modern, professional, mobile-friendly, and SEO-optimized business website. Website requirements: Professional and visually appealing UI/UX design. Fully responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop. SEO-friendly website structure and URLs. Integration with Google Business Profile and Google Maps. Contact forms to generate customer inquiries and leads. Click-to-call and WhatsApp integration. Dedicated service pages optimized for local search keywords. Additional expectations: Website content should be optimized for both search engines and potential customers. Clear calls to action (CTAs) to encourage visitors to call, message, or submit inquiries. Basic website maintenance and technical support. 3. Visual Branding & Content Creation Design and upload high-converting branded visual assets, including cover photos, logo optimization, and service graphics. Optimize photos before uploading them. Create and publish engaging weekly Google Posts (offers, updates, and service highlights) for the first month. Maintain consistent branding across the website and Google Business Profile. 4. Local SEO & Google Maps Ranking Build high-authority local citations and directory listings relevant to my industry and location. Optimize the Q&A section with relevant customer questions and answers. Conduct local keyword research and competitor analysis. Develop a local SEO strategy to improve organic rankings and Google Maps visibility. Optimize website pages for relevant local search terms. Build relevant, high-quality backlinks using white-hat SEO techniques. 5. Review Growth Strategy Set up a simple system, QR code, or template to help collect more genuine customer reviews. Write professional, SEO-friendly responses to existing and new customer reviews. Develop a strategy to consistently increase authentic customer feedback. No fake reviews or incentivized review manipulation. 6. Reporting & Performance Tracking Provide a clear before-and-after ranking report using Local Search Grid/Heat Map tools. Track Google Business Profile views, website clicks, calls, and direction requests. Track website traffic, keyword rankings, organic clicks, and conversions. Provide monthly performance reports with actionable recommendations. Requirements for Applicants Proven track record of ranking Google Business Profiles in the Top 3 Local Map Pack. Please share 2–3 recent case studies or screenshots demonstrating previous results. Strong knowledge of Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, and Google Maps ranking factors. Experience in website design and development, including WordPress or modern web technologies. Knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, schema markup, and website speed optimization. Strong graphic design skills (Canva/Photoshop) for creating professional GBP posts and banners. Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and local ranking tracking tools. Strict adherence to Google's white-hat guidelines. No fake reviews, keyword stuffing in business names, or spam tactics that could risk profile suspension. Expected Outcome I am looking for someone who can handle both the website and local SEO requirements end-to-end. The primary objective is to: Rank the Google Business Profile among the Top 3 local Map Pack results for relevant keywords. Build a professional website that attracts visitors and converts them into customers. Improve organic visibility on Google Search. Generate consistent calls, WhatsApp messages, and customer inquiries. Establish a strong and sustainable online presence. Please include your portfolio, previous SEO results, website development examples, proposed strategy, estimated timeline, and pricing when applying. https://docs.google.com/document/d/1U83CGb1xq8dbxPomR0KMHMIa63FoHCTt2E9QTe4obWw/edit?usp=sharing"

opportunities.title: Amazon Repricing Automation Tool
opportunities.description: I hold all my listings inside Amazon Seller Central and I’m spending far too much time tweaking prices by hand. I need a small application or script that watches what my competitors are doing and instantly updates my price so I always match the lowest competing offer on each ASIN—never a cent higher, never lower than a floor I will provide. The core workflow I’m after is straightforward: 1. Pull current competitor pricing for every ASIN I sell (Amazon SP-API or another proven method). 2. Compare my offer to the lowest competitor price. 3. If I’m higher, push an updated price that exactly matches that competitor. 4. If I already share or hold the lowest price, leave mine unchanged. 5. Respect a per-ASIN minimum price I can maintain in a simple CSV or through an admin screen. 6. Run on an adjustable schedule (cron job, Lambda, or similar) and log every change for transparency. Language and stack are flexible—Python, Node.js, or another server-side option is fine as long as it can authenticate through Amazon’s API and is easy for me to deploy on a small cloud instance. Deliverables • Fully commented source code and installation steps • Simple configuration file or UI for ASINs, minimum prices, and timing interval • A short README explaining how to obtain and plug in Amazon SP-API credentials • Demonstration on a handful of test ASINs to show the repricer working in real time Once I can run this and see my prices adjust automatically to match the current lowest competitor, the project is complete.

opportunities.title: Automate Legal Documents on WordPress
opportunities.description: Project Brief: Automated Legal Document Production System Project Overview We are looking for an experienced developer to build a simple, cost-effective automated legal document production system for an existing law firm. Important: We already have an existing WordPress website. We do NOT need a new website built. The project involves adding legal services and fixed-fee document packages to the existing WordPress website, allowing clients to purchase services, complete online questionnaires, upload supporting documents and receive professionally prepared legal documents following solicitor approval. We need Stripe integrated into the existing website so clients can select a service, make payment and complete the required onboarding process. We have a strict project budget and are looking for someone who can deliver a practical, reliable solution without unnecessary complexity or expensive custom development. Required Workflow Existing WordPress website: Add legal services and fixed-fee document packages to the existing website, including service descriptions, pricing and inclusions. Online purchasing: Integrate Stripe into the existing WordPress website so clients can purchase their selected legal service. Questionnaire: Following service selection, clients complete an online questionnaire and upload relevant supporting documents. CRM integration and conflict checks: Connect to the firm's existing SILQ CRM to identify existing clients, check relevant parties for potential conflicts and flag potential matches for solicitor review. New client details and approved matters must be saved in SILQ. Conflicts must not be automatically cleared by AI. Engagement and payment: Client receives the relevant costs agreement, accepts the terms and completes payment through Stripe. Matter acceptance and payment must be verified before document production begins. Automation: n8n triggers the workflow following verified payment and the required matter acceptance checks. AI processing: OpenAI extracts and structures client information, while Claude prepares documents using approved legal templates and instructions. Document generation: Generate professionally formatted, branded and fully editable Microsoft Word (.docx) and PDF documents. Solicitor review: Provide a simple, secure interface where solicitors can review documents, download Word/PDF versions, manually edit Word documents and upload revised versions. AI amendments: Solicitors can request AI amendments or make their own manual changes. All document versions must be retained. Final approval: A solicitor must explicitly approve the final document before it can be released. Client delivery: Automatically deliver the approved document securely by email. Feedback: Send an automated client feedback or review request. Required Technology We would prefer to use existing services and avoid unnecessary custom software development. WordPress: Existing website. Add services, purchasing functionality and questionnaires. Stripe: Payment processing integrated into the existing website. n8n: Workflow automation. SILQ: Existing CRM and legal practice management system. OpenAI API: Information extraction. Claude API: Legal document drafting. Microsoft Word (.docx) and PDF: Document generation. Important Requirements Work with our existing WordPress website. Do not rebuild it. Add legal services and fixed-fee packages to the existing website. Allow clients to purchase services, complete questionnaires and upload documents online. Integrate Stripe for secure payments. Integrate with the firm's existing SILQ CRM. Do not build another CRM. Support client searches, potential conflict identification and new client/matter creation, subject to SILQ API capabilities. Maintain secure document storage and client confidentiality. Provide downloadable and editable Word documents. Allow solicitors to manually amend and re-upload documents. Maintain document version history. Require solicitor approval before documents are sent to clients. Include basic error handling and workflow notifications. Budget, Scope and Proposal We have a strict budget for this project and are looking for the most affordable practical solution. If you are interested in bidding, please provide: Your best fixed-price quote for delivering the project. A clear breakdown of exactly what is included in your proposed scope. Your estimated development timeframe and delivery milestones. Any additional ongoing costs, including hosting, API usage, subscriptions or third-party services. Confirmation that you have experience with WordPress, Stripe, n8n, API integrations, AI document generation and CRM integrations. Any recommendations for simplifying the implementation or reducing costs without compromising essential functionality. Please distinguish between essential functionality and optional enhancements. We are open to practical alternatives if they achieve the same outcome at a lower cost. Our preference is a straightforward, reliable and affordable solution that builds on our existing WordPress website rather than creating an entirely new platform.

opportunities.title: SolidWorks Mechanical Designer, Custom Machines
opportunities.description: I’m expanding my team for a surge of custom-machine projects and need an experienced mechanical designer who can jump straight into SolidWorks, translate rough concepts into clean 3D models, and generate shop-ready fabrication drawings. Most assignments revolve around one-off machines and equipment rather than repeat fixtures, so each job starts with a blank screen, field measurements at the customer’s plant, and direct coordination with fabricators. You’ll take my initial direction, capture those site dimensions accurately, and then drive the design through to release—owns BOMs, detail drawings, and the inevitable revisions that arise once steel starts getting cut. Key expectations • 5–10 years of hands-on industrial mechanical design, ideally across tooling, material-handling devices, or small automated stations. • Mastery of SolidWorks for part, assembly, and drawing creation; familiarity with Creo or AutoCAD is helpful for legacy conversions but not mandatory. • Proven ability to communicate clearly with shop personnel, welders, and machinists so designs build exactly as intended. • Comfort visiting plants, climbing around equipment for measurements, and translating what you see into workable models. • BS in Mechanical Engineering is a plus; practical ingenuity matters more. Deliverables for each project 1. Fully constrained SolidWorks assemblies and native part files. 2. Detail and layout drawings (PDF + DWG) with weld symbols, tolerances, and bill of materials. 3. Revision-controlled drawing pack ready for issue to fabrication. 4. Brief design summary noting key design decisions and any open items. If you thrive on solving mechanical problems from scratch and can back your ideas with clear, fabrication-friendly documentation, let’s talk—there’s a steady queue of machines waiting for your touch.

opportunities.title: Remote Financial Controller & Analyst
opportunities.description: Freelance Financial Controller & Financial Analyst – Project-Based Collaboration Work arrangement: 100% Remote Contract type: Freelance / Project-Based Field: Financial Controlling, Financial Analysis & Business Intelligence About the Opportunity We are seeking individuals with strong financial and analytical skills, advanced Excel proficiency, and the ability to work independently on clearly defined assignments. This is a project-based opportunity, with the potential for ongoing collaboration as our client portfolio grows. Key Responsibilities Prepare and update monthly Profit & Loss (P&L) statements. Analyze revenue, expenses, margins, and profitability. Develop financial budgets and forecasts. Perform budget vs. actual variance analysis. Build and maintain financial models and management tools in Excel. Prepare financial reports, dashboards, and management KPIs. Analyze cash flow, accounts receivable, and accounts payable. Organize, process, and validate accounting and financial data. Automate financial reporting processes. Support the development of financial controlling solutions for SMEs. Requirements Degree or relevant background in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. Previous experience in financial controlling, financial analysis, accounting, or similar roles. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Strong understanding of financial statements, management accounting, and financial reporting. Ability to work with financial datasets and identify inconsistencies. Excellent analytical thinking, attention to detail, and organizational skills. Ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Power BI and Power Query. Financial modeling and forecasting experience. Familiarity with ERP and accounting systems. Previous experience supporting SMEs or financial consulting firms. Knowledge of financial automation and reporting optimization. Collaboration Terms Fully remote work. Freelance collaboration based on individual projects and deliverables. Project scope, deadlines, and compensation agreed upon in advance. Flexible working arrangements. Opportunity to establish a long-term professional relationship. Applicants must be legally authorized to provide and invoice international freelance services from their country of residence. How to Apply Please include the following information in your proposal: A brief introduction and summary of your professional experience. Your educational background and main financial skills. Your proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and other relevant tools. Examples of previous financial models, dashboards, or reporting projects, if available and free of confidential information. Your project-based fees. Your availability for upcoming projects. We are looking for reliable, detail-oriented professionals interested in building a long-term working relationship based on quality, confidentiality, and professional commitment.
