opportunities.title: RateperSQFT - AI-Powered Real Estate CRM Overhaul
opportunities.description: I operate a 20-person real-estate consultancy that already uses a custom PHP + Vue CRM. Leads pour in every day from website forms, landing pages, property portals, social-media ads, phone calls, WhatsApp and even walk-ins, and my call-center and field executives juggle them manually. I now want one holistic, AI-enabled platform that takes every contact from first click or call all the way to closed deal, without fragmenting the workflow into separate “modules”. What the upgraded system must do end-to-end • Capture every lead in real time, auto-deduplicate it and route it to the right agent or field executive. • Record each inbound and outbound call, transcribe it, summarise key points and schedule next-step reminders automatically. • Trigger follow-up calls, WhatsApp messages or emails on an AI-driven schedule until the prospect converts or opts out. • Track property visits, geo-stamp each check-in, collect notes and photos on-site and roll them into performance dashboards. • Present live dashboards that show individual and team performance, conversion funnels and property-wise insights. • Plug seamlessly into (or fully replace) the current PHP + Vue code base without disrupting daily operations. Acceptance criteria 1. A working demo handling sample leads from all stated sources. 2. Automated call summaries and follow-up tasks visible inside the CRM. 3. Field-visit logs with location and time stamps reflected in reports. 4. Clear documentation and hand-over of source code, AI models/APIs used, and deployment steps. I’m open to the specific AI stack you recommend as long as it integrates cleanly with PHP + Vue and scales with the volume we handle.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40831573, publicado hace 9 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 1,250 - 2,500.

opportunities.title: Detailed Figurine STL Creation
opportunities.description: I have a mock-up of a small decorative figurine that I’d like turned into an STL file ready for 3D printing. The piece should preserve the proportions and personality shown in the concept while adding enough definition to make facial features, edges, and surface transitions crisp on a home FDM or resin printer. I’ll share the reference images, overall dimensions, and a few notes on where I need sharper lines versus smoother curves. From there, please model the figurine, check that the mesh is watertight and manifold, and orient it so supports are kept to a minimum. When you’re done, send the ready-to-print STL along with the editable source file (BLEND, OBJ, or similar) in case small tweaks are needed later. If you have questions about wall thickness, undercuts, or preferred tolerances, let me know up front so we can dial those in before the final export.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp & Website AI Automation
opportunities.description: I run two separate service-based businesses and I’m ready to let an AI assistant take over our front-line chats. The first milestone is simple: I want instant, accurate replies on both WhatsApp Business and the embedded website chat widget. Here’s what the assistant must be able to do from day one: • Answer the everyday questions we get about services, prices, and opening hours. • Collect each visitor’s name, phone, and brief enquiry, then push those leads to my team inbox or CRM in real time. • Guide customers through booking, rescheduling, or cancelling appointments—syncing seamlessly with our existing calendar tool. When the AI hits a question it can’t handle, it should politely ask the customer for their contact details so a human can call back. No dead ends, no robotic “I don’t know” loops. I’m open to platforms—Dialogflow, GPT-4o, Twilio WhatsApp API, ManyChat, Zendesk Sunshine, you name it—as long as the final solution plugs into both businesses without forcing me to pay for two entirely separate setups. Clear documentation, hand-off instructions, and a brief live demo will be the acceptance criteria. If you’ve built conversational flows for small businesses before and can show they work in production, I’m ready to get started right away.

opportunities.title: Mumbai Interior & Airbnb Marketer
opportunities.description: My interior design studio and nearby Airbnb properties in Andheri West need a single, on-site voice that keeps both brands equally visible and engaging. The role centres on creating and executing a coherent strategy that pushes out design tips, short videos and behind-the-scenes footage while nudging followers toward bookings and design inquiries at the same pace. Daily work happens from our studio so you can capture fresh content, style rooms for quick shoots and immediately share updates across the three channels that matter most to us: Instagram, Google Business Profile and WhatsApp. Expect to: • Plan and publish a balanced calendar that splits attention between the design portfolio and the Airbnb listings • Film, edit and post Reels, stories and short-form video showcasing makeovers, project progress, guest moments and special offers • Optimise our Google Business Profile with timely posts, reviews management and photo updates • Keep WhatsApp broadcasts lively with sneak peeks, promo codes and prompt reply to client or guest queries • Track insights, refine hashtags and recommend small paid pushes when organic reach needs a lift You’ll work full-time or part-time on site (we can discuss hours) and collaborate directly with the design team, photographer and housekeeping staff to gather assets quickly. If you already know what resonates with Mumbai design lovers and regular Airbnb travellers—and have the analytics to prove it—send over your profile and a few success stories so we can start planning the first month’s calendar together.

opportunities.description: We have an existing Meta-verified Business Portfolio registered in Afghanistan with two active WhatsApp Business Platform Messaging Accounts. This is consultation/troubleshooting only initially. We do not need a new WhatsApp API implementation. Please apply only if you have specifically handled Meta WhatsApp Business billing/payment issues before. In your proposal, please explain: Whether you have resolved this type of Meta payment failure previously. Whether failure before authorization reaches the issuing bank indicates a Meta-side payment/risk restriction. Whether you have experience with Meta billing for businesses registered in Afghanistan or nearby markets. What you would check first.

I’m opening up 40 % commission on every confirmed purchase, tracked through my dedicated affiliate link. You can plug directly into my existing sales page and link—no need to build funnels from scratch. What I need is creative promotion on Instagram and YouTube: reels, shorts, community posts, reviews, whatever converts best for your audience. The book is priced to be an impulse buy, so quick, value-packed content tends to perform well. Deliverables I’ll review for payment: • Your unique affiliate link request so I can activate tracking • At least two live posts or videos on Instagram or YouTube within the first week • A brief performance summary (views, clicks, sales) at the end of each month so we can optimize together Once a sale shows in the dashboard, I release your 40% share immediately. If you already have a following hungry for new income ideas, this should be an effortless add-on to your content calendar. Let’s grow our earnings side by side.

opportunities.title: Agente Telefónico Hostel Online
opportunities.description: Necesito a alguien que atienda todas las llamadas de mi hostel online. Las conversaciones serán exclusivamente en español y, en su mayoría, giran en torno a consultas sobre disponibilidad y precios de las habitaciones. Lo que espero de tu trabajo: • Contestar cada llamada dentro del horario acordado, con un tono cordial y profesional. • Verificar disponibilidad y tarifas en nuestro motor de reservas antes de dar una respuesta. • Registrar en una hoja de seguimiento el nombre del interesado, fechas solicitadas y el resultado de la conversación. • Escalar al correo interno cualquier solicitud especial o incidencia que no puedas resolver en el momento. Requisitos mínimos: • Español nativo y excelente presencia telefónica. • Conexión a internet estable y micrófono de buena calidad. • Experiencia previa en atención hotelera, call centers o reservas online. • Manejo fluido de herramientas VoIP (CloudTalk, Aircall o similares). Proporciono manual de preguntas frecuentes, acceso a la línea VoIP y credenciales del PMS. Empezaremos con un turno de prueba de una semana; si todo marcha bien, la colaboración será a largo plazo. Indícame tu disponibilidad horaria y cualquier experiencia relevante cuando envíes tu propuesta.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40831255, publicado hace 13 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 15 - 25.

opportunities.title: FlutterFlow MVP para Viajeros
opportunities.description: Necesito un MVP completamente funcional en FlutterFlow para una app dirigida a quienes visitan Costa Rica. El prototipo debe estar listo lo antes posible. La app combina tres pilares: permite planificar itinerarios y rutas personalizados, facilita la búsqueda y reserva de tours, actividades y alojamientos, y ofrece recomendaciones locales confiables sobre transporte, gastronomía y puntos de interés. Quiero que todo esto conviva en un flujo limpio, en español e inglés, y con una interfaz que pueda refinarse rápidamente a partir de feedback real de usuarios. Entrego la arquitectura de contenidos, algunos wireframes y la paleta de colores; tú te encargas de montarlo en FlutterFlow, conectar los datos con Firestore (o la opción que sugieras) y dejar configuradas las principales pantallas: onboarding, exploración con filtros, itinerario interactivo, ficha de proveedor y pasarela de reserva (mock o sandbox, según el tiempo). Por favor incluye: • Un enlace al proyecto en FlutterFlow para poder iterar juntos • Acceso de tipo “viewer” para mi equipo • Instrucciones breves de despliegue en Android e iOS (builds de prueba) Valoro experiencia previa con FlutterFlow, Firebase/Firestore y diseño orientado a viajeros. Si puedes empezar de inmediato y entregarme la primera versión en cuestión de días, házmelo saber en tu propuesta junto con un par de ejemplos de trabajos similares.

opportunities.title: Development of an AI Agent for E-Commerce Order Processing
opportunities.description: I am seeking a skilled freelancer to assist in creating an advanced AI voice agent to enhance the customer experience in order processing for my business. This project aims to integrate AI-driven solutions for seamless operations. Key Requirements: - Develop an AI agent capable of processing orders with precision and efficiency. - Ensure integration with existing applications to streamline workflows. - Maintain a user-friendly and intuitive interface for customer interactions. Expected agent features: - Accurately collect order details, including products, quantities, shipping, and payment. - Provide clear and helpful instructions to guide customers through the process. - Suggest additional relevant products and apply discounts appropriately. - Handle special requests and provide comprehensive order confirmations. AI Agent Prompt: You are an AI specialist in order processing designed to create seamless shopping experiences. Instructions: 1) Guide customers through order processing with clear instructions. 2) Collect accurate information (products, quantities, shipping, and payment). 3) Confirm order details before completion to avoid errors. 4) Suggest additional relevant products and apply available discounts. 5) Clearly explain shipping options and return policies. 6) Handle special requests efficiently. 7) Provide confirmations for completed orders while maintaining a friendly attitude.

opportunities.title: Guionista para Series Cortas Virales
opportunities.description: Busco guionista para series cortas de redes sociales (2 minutos) Estoy buscando un guionista creativo que tenga experiencia desarrollando historias originales y atractivas para vídeos cortos de aproximadamente 2 minutos, destinados a TikTok, Instagram Reels y Facebook. ¿Qué necesito? * Crear historias originales, impactantes y con potencial viral. * Escribir guiones que enganchen al espectador desde los primeros 3 segundos. * Desarrollar historias con emoción, suspenso, giros inesperados y finales memorables. * Utilizar una narrativa dinámica que mantenga la atención hasta el último segundo. Importante: El trabajo consiste exclusivamente en desarrollar la historia y escribir el guion. No necesito edición de vídeo, grabación, locución ni producción audiovisual. Busco una persona creativa, con imaginación, excelente capacidad narrativa y conocimiento de lo que funciona en las redes sociales. La idea es comenzar con algunos guiones de prueba y, si existe buena química creativa, establecer una colaboración recurrente. Para presentar tu candidatura: Envíame ejemplos de guiones que hayas escrito, tu experiencia y cuánto cobrarías por cada guion de aproximadamente 2 minutos. ¡Busco talento, originalidad y buenas historias!

opportunities.title: Editor Gameplays y Reels Dinámicos
opportunities.description: Cuento con grabaciones de series completas de gameplay y quiero publicarlas en YouTube y Facebook en formato largo, además de extraer los mejores momentos para clips verticales que funcionen en Instagram Reels y TikTok. Para los episodios extensos solo necesito una edición limpia: corta silencios, elimina tiempos muertos y deja el audio parejo; nada de efectos recargados. En cambio, los clips breves sí deben sentirse ágiles y llamativos, resaltando las jugadas clave con cortes rápidos y, cuando sume, un pequeño zoom o texto que enfatice la acción. Entrego los archivos fuente y espero los videos finales en 1080p: • Gameplay completo en 16:9, listo para subir. • Pack de clips verticales (9:16) de entre 15 y 60 s cada uno. Una muestra inicial lo antes posible me ayudará a confirmar estilo; no será demasiado contenido, por lo que la rapidez es importante. Quedo atento a cualquier duda técnica sobre códecs o formatos para que podamos avanzar de inmediato.

opportunities.title: Presupuesto Eléctrico Presto y Cype
opportunities.description: Dispongo de los planos y especificaciones completas de un edificio comercial/industrial y necesito un presupuesto eléctrico integral elaborado con Presto y Cypelec-Cypetec. El trabajo debe cubrir: • Materiales, mano de obra y equipos con precios actualizados. • Mediciones detalladas y listado claro de partidas. • Planos eléctricos revisados y memoria técnica que justifique cálculos y normativas aplicadas. Entrego la documentación base en formato DWG/PDF; espero el archivo Presto totalmente parametrizado, los modelos o tablas generadas en Cype y un juego PDF listo para presentar al cliente final. Busco precisión en cuantías, claridad en los criterios de cálculo y consistencia entre todos los documentos.
